note: Independent source rejudgment. draft-ietf-bess-mup-safi-01 Section 3.1.3.1 (rfc/drafts/draft-ietf-bess-mup-safi.txt:439-441): "- 1: encoding is invalid (a valid TLV requires at minimum a Type byte and a Length byte); MUST be treated as Treat-as-withdraw." Read both tagged units in full: TestMUPT1STTLVFraming in internal/component/bgp/plugins/nlri/mup/draft_ietf_bess_mup_safi_tlv_mup_test.go accepts a complete TLV and requires ErrMUPTLV for exactly one byte after the zero Source Address Length; TestMUPMalformedT1STTreatAsWithdraw in internal/component/bgp/reactor/draft_ietf_bess_mup_safi_t1st_withdraw_test.go first receives valid K0, then the same route key with the lone TLV byte 0xf0. It requires exact ActionNone/no reset, exact surviving sibling bytes, and MP_UNREACH containing exactly K0, checked decodable, not merely disappearance of K. Producers read: mup/types.go ParseMUP, ValidateNLRI, decode, parseBodyT1ST and validateTLVs; mup/rfc7606.go recognizerFor; reactor/session_validation.go applyRFC7606; session_validation_nlritype.go applyTypedNLRIDiscard, typedNLRIEdit, typedNLRIRelayEdit and typedNLRIPlaceWithdrawals; session_validation_nlritype_held.go typedNLRIWalk.withdrawal. The complete mandatory body isolates the lone-byte framing fault; the parser rejects it, recognizer returns Withdraw and the held generation supplies the withdrawal. Section 3.1.3 makes RD/Prefix Length/Prefix the key, so K0 names the route being removed. Scope has no partial or exclusion annotation. No checks or native discrimination run by this auditor.
